messages:
ashwin: heads up — gpu-rack-12-slot3 went into a flapping state during the 6h soak. saw repeated kernel Xid errors and ECC reports. i drained it but want to reproduce before we put back in rotation

maria: ack. what error codes are we seeing? any nvml output?

ashwin: pasted a snippet from dmesg earlier:
```
NVRM: Xid (13): 00000000: 25:13:0a
NVRM: GPU has fallen off the bus.
Kernel: GPU ECC error: channel 2, single-bit, addr 0x7ff...\n```
Also `nvidia-smi -q` shows ECC corrections rising during the soak.

devon: can you attach the soakbench config you used? want to replicate exact load pattern.

ashwin: using soakbench with mixed-attention-gen and repeated long-context streams. config excerpt:
```
soakbench --pattern=llm-mix --workers=8 --duration=6h --seq=2048 --batch=1
```
I can re-run with the thermal-cycler profile (power-cycling between runs) if we think temp cycling triggers it.

sree: minor note — this rack is in eu-west-1-azb and we only have 2 spare gpus there. prefer to avoid long OOS if we can get a quick repro. maybe run the reproducer in staging (cluster alpha) first.

maria: steps i suggest:
1) collect `nvidia-bug-report.sh` and `dmesg` + `/var/log/messages`
2) reseat GPU and cables -> quick smoke run (5-10m)
3) if flake persists: run extended thermal cycle reproducer for 12-48h with ECC scrubbing enabled
4) if deterministic -> tag for RMA and include the bugreport + last 48h soakbench logs

ashwin: will run the quick smoke now after reseat. if it still flaps i can kick off a 24h thermal cycle run on alpha (dev cluster) to avoid eu capacity impact.

qa-bot: scheduled job #soak-1887 started on cluster-alpha (gpu-slot-sim-07) with config: `thermal-cycle: true, cycles: 24, pattern: llm-mix, seq:2048`

devon: couple of troubleshooting commands to add to the run script:
- `watch -n 10 nvidia-smi dmon -s u`
- `while true; do dmesg --ctime | tail -n 50; sleep 30; done > /tmp/dmesg-tail.log &`
- capture NVML stats every minute via `python3 nvml_poll.py --out nvml.csv --interval 60`

maria: also enable ECC scrubbing counters if not already on. we need to know if corrections are accumulating continuously vs spiking.

ashwin: smoke after reseat: short run 15m, no Xid observed. i'll leave it uncordoned until 24h thermal cycle completes on alpha. moving the rack back in rotation only after we get clean 24h.

sree: thanks. add a note to the ticket to avoid scheduling large batches to eu-west-1 until we confirm. putting a soft capacity hold. (reaction :lock:)

devon: if thermal cycle reproduces, try swapping the card with a known-good in the same slot. if error follows card -> RMA. if stays -> investigate slot/slot-power.

ashwin: agreed. i'll update the ticket with bugreport and soak logs. will post final verdict after 24h run.

oncall-bot: reminder: if node remains flagged after 48h, escalate to hw-ops and open RMA request template.
